text.p: O'Gara Co said Tuesday it settled a lawsuit against the company by private O'Gara Protective Services for $75,000 and an agreement not to comepete against O'Gara Protective for certain customers.
O'Gara Protective is owned by Edward O'Gara, a brother of O'Gara's chief executive Bill O'Gara and O'Gara's chairman Thomas O'Gara, a company spokesman said.
O'Gara Protective, a security services company, had filed suit against O'Gara, claiming O'Gara's subsidiary O'Gara-Hess & Eisenhardt had agreed not to compete against it, the spokesman said.
O'Gara Co is an integrated security company. Its stock traded at 12-3/4 Tuesday afternoon, up 1/2.
